summary: Retain external-input dependencies for cached mission file observations

schema.detail: No schema, index or store-version changes.

rules.detail: Cached file observations retain their external-input dependency independently of the narrower actual-state dependency, so settled mission gates remain subscribed to filesystem changes. This fragment classifies the cached-observation correction without changing the immutable scoped file-watch release fragment.

compatibility.detail: Existing mission declarations and filesystem observation semantics remain supported.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.
